facts.en: Completed a logistics administration diploma at Fictional Silvermoss College in 2020.

facts.en: Worked as a paid dispatch assistant at Fictional Lanternwheel Hire, starting in 2021 and ending in 2024-02; the start month is not recorded.

facts.en: Maintained equipment booking sheets and matched collection windows to customer requests.

facts.en: Personally tested booking-reference and return-date fields using 18 invented examples.
facts.zh: 个人使用 18 个虚构示例测试预订编号及归还日期字段。

facts.en: The depot supervisor approved the checklist; the candidate did not design equipment-safety procedures.
